name: catalyst-edge-mcp
description: Source-linked market intelligence for AI agents researching public-company tickers.
long_description: Catalyst Edge Research exposes exactly two read-only MCP tools for ticker-level evidence research. Scores are deterministic, unbacktested, and non-advisory. The public default uses official SEC data plus attributed GDELT discovery metadata; other providers remain disabled.

tools.name: catalyst_edge_score
tools.description: Use for ticker research to assess recent evidence, provenance, confidence, and next checks.

tools.name: catalyst_edge_claim_sources
tools.description: Use with a dossier claim ID to read one bounded page of its immutable source records.

sec_user_agent.title: SEC monitored identity
sec_user_agent.description: Required SEC identity in Company email@example.com form. It is sent to sec.gov with requests.

evidence_store.title: Local evidence-store path
evidence_store.description: Optional absolute path for the local SQLite evidence store.
